confidence_notes: Darjeeling restaurant and coffee anchors use local published estimates, checked against broader India benchmarks. Beer uses a recent local range and the India benchmark; cocktail uses one local bar menu, while wine is inferred from its relationship to local beer. Accommodation is a holistic estimate without current listing checks, and alcohol data are sparse.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single city comparator used. Darjeeling is a compact Himalayan tourist town, so food and lodging are estimated above small-town India baselines but below major metro levels.
